# math_testpaper_generator

> AI-assisted Korean mathematics exam conversion. The calling AI reads/translates a supplied PDF; this repository typesets and validates the result without an AI API or desktop automation.

- [AI instructions](AGENTS.md): Read first. Complete PDF-to-JSON-to-PDF workflow and review gates.
- [Quick entry](AI_START_HERE.md): Short command sequence.
- [Data format](docs/format.md): Rich text, TeX, source references, figures, custom fonts.
- [Schema](schema/exam.schema.json): Version 1 interchange format.
- [Demo](examples/demo/exam.json): Original, runnable mathematical questions.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Coordinate system and verification limits.
